veranderings.na: Op die roetes daarheen was daar
veranderings.rede: 'hierdie roetes' points back to routes the lesson has not yet named; 'die roetes daarheen' ties them to the journey just described, and the protected phrase is untouched.

veranderings.voor: 'n Lang pad te voet vra elke dag water en kos.
veranderings.na: Wie lank te voet reis, het elke dag water en kos nodig.
veranderings.rede: A road that 'asks for' water and food is wooden personification; the rewrite says the same thing naturally.

veranderings.voor: Wilde diere in dieselfde veld as die pad.
veranderings.na: Wilde diere in die veld waardeur die pad geloop het.
veranderings.rede: 'in dieselfde veld as die pad' is an awkward comparison construction; the rewrite keeps the meaning and reads naturally.

veranderings.voor: Water wat in die droë maande ver uitmekaar was
veranderings.na: Waterplekke wat in die droë maande ver uitmekaar was
veranderings.rede: Water itself is not 'far apart'; the places where water could be found were.

veranderings.voor: Siekte, ver van hulp by die huis.
veranderings.na: Siekte, ver van die huis en van hulp.
veranderings.rede: 'ver van hulp by die huis' can be misread as being far from help while at home; the rewrite makes clear the traveller is far from home and its help.

veranderings.blok: Hoe hulle die pad gevind het
veranderings.voor: Die land self het vir die reisigers gewys
veranderings.na: Die land self het vir hulle gewys
veranderings.rede: Avoids repeating 'reisigers' from the sentence directly before; 'hulle' refers back to it unambiguously.

veranderings.voor: Die pad wat mense volg van een plek na 'n ander.
veranderings.na: Die pad wat mense van een plek na 'n ander volg.
veranderings.rede: In an Afrikaans relative clause the verb goes last; 'volg' after the prepositional phrase is the natural order.
